testimonials.name: Dr. Rajesh Kumar
testimonials.text: KA Software transformed our healthcare operations with their AI diagnostic platform. The accuracy and speed improvements have been remarkable. Highly recommended!

testimonials.name: Priya Sharma
testimonials.text: The e-commerce platform they built exceeded our expectations. Sales increased by 40% within the first quarter. Their AI recommendations are game-changing.

testimonials.name: Arun Menon
testimonials.text: Implementing their HRMS solution streamlined our entire HR process. The AI-powered recruitment feature saved us countless hours and improved hire quality.

testimonials.name: Divya Krishnan
testimonials.text: We moved from a marketplace to our own store built by KA Software and doubled our margins. The WhatsApp cart recovery alone pays for everything.

testimonials.name: Mohammed Faizal
testimonials.text: Three branches, one dashboard. Stock mismatches dropped to almost zero and GST filing went from two days to twenty minutes. Brilliant POS system.

testimonials.name: Karthik Subramanian
testimonials.text: Deploys used to be a Friday-evening ritual of fear. Their CI/CD setup means even our interns ship to production safely now.

testimonials.name: Sneha Reddy
testimonials.text: Their AI chatbot answers 4 out of 5 customer chats end to end. Two support agents now handle what used to need eight people.

testimonials.name: Lakshmi Narayanan
testimonials.role: Head of HR, SRM Auto Components
testimonials.text: Payroll for 1,800 employees used to take a full week. Now it is one morning - and statutory audits are painless. Best decision we made.

testimonials.name: Suresh Kumar
testimonials.text: Customer rejections dropped 70% in three months with their vision inspection system. The line stops itself before a batch is ruined.

testimonials.name: Anita Desai
testimonials.text: We process 40,000 vendor invoices a month. Their document AI cut our data entry workload by 90% and month-end closing by a full week.

testimonials.name: Dr. Vignesh Prabhu
testimonials.text: We used to miss 30% of calls during clinic hours. Their AI voice agent books those patients automatically - two extra days of appointments every week.

testimonials.name: Arjun Mehta
testimonials.text: We moved from spreadsheets to their CRM and closed 35% more deals in the first quarter with the same team. The AI lead ranking is scary accurate.

testimonials.name: Priya Raghavan
testimonials.text: Average class scores went up 18% in one term with their AI tutor. Students actually enjoy asking the questions they were too shy to ask in class.

testimonials.name: Rahul Bhandari
testimonials.text: Our Monday review went from arguing about whose Excel was right to deciding what to do next. One source of truth changed everything.

testimonials.name: Nikhil Sharma
testimonials.text: Their reconciliation agent processes 12,000 transactions nightly and flags exactly the 20 that need a human. That job used to take three analysts.

testimonials.name: Meena Iyer
testimonials.text: Professional team with clear communication throughout. Our online store launched on schedule and the festival-season traffic did not even slow it down.

testimonials.name: Vikram Chandran
testimonials.text: They understood our business before writing a single line of code. The ERP integration works flawlessly with our 20-year-old processes.

testimonials.name: Sandhya Nair
testimonials.text: Patient appointment no-shows dropped 45% after their automated WhatsApp reminder system went live. Simple idea, perfectly executed.

testimonials.name: Ramesh Gupta
testimonials.text: From order to doorstep, the delivery app they built handles everything. Route optimisation alone saves us two hours per driver daily.

testimonials.name: Kavitha Balan
testimonials.text: Our student portal handles 15,000 concurrent users during exam results without a hiccup. Rock-solid engineering and a lovely UI.

testimonials.name: Joseph Antony
testimonials.text: Real-time shipment tracking transformed our customer relationships. Clients stopped calling to ask 'where is my cargo' - they just check the app.

testimonials.name: Deepa Venkatesh
testimonials.text: The booking system paid for itself in the first month. Online bookings doubled and the automated reminders ended our no-show problem.

testimonials.name: Santosh Pillai
testimonials.text: Their ML model predicts crop yield with accuracy our agronomists did not believe until they saw a full season of results. Serious AI capability.

testimonials.name: Fatima Begum
testimonials.text: Admissions season used to overwhelm our office. Their CRM now manages 8,000 enquiries effortlessly and our conversion rate is up 25%.
